   `content_tests` in every Today pick and cron run, so deploying it without 0022 breaks Today, the metrics cron and the
   Performance pages. Do not merge until the migration is applied.

   `content_tests` in every Today pick and cron run, so deploying it without 0022 breaks Today, the metrics cron and the
   Performance pages. Do not merge until the migration is applied.

   `content_tests` in every Today pick and cron run, so deploying it without 0022 breaks Today, the metrics cron and the
   Performance pages. Do not merge until the migration is applied.
